purpose: Production-relevant full-attention SFT control, sharing its training and evaluation contracts with later KV-mask SFT and entropy RL.

evaluation.aishell4_dev: unavailable; never select on its test set
evaluation.early_stop: stop after two successive full-dev checkpoints worsen selection_score by >=0.5 percentage points versus best completed checkpoint; first full checkpoint is also compared to step0 base
evaluation.tie_break: earliest eligible checkpoint within 0.1 percentage points of best score
evaluation.no_eligible_checkpoint: report no accepted SFT; keep base as production fallback; no test-driven retuning
evaluation.threshold_note: Operational criteria fixed before v2 generation, not statistical significance claims.

checkpoints.stage_stop: callback at milestone with horizon=402 retained; do not reset schedule or data order when resuming

entry_gates: Verify source and data hashes plus installed package versions; pin the verified training processor class.
One full 4-GPU FP32 update with a global batch including the longest 116527-token meeting; finite loss/gradients and measured GPU/RAM headroom.
Numerical comparison of single-GPU accumulation4 and DDP4 on one identical global batch, using an independent global token denominator.
Save, unload, reload and resume while preserving FP32 parameters and Adam moments, step, data order and the 402-step scheduler horizon.
Confirm prediction logits agree between live training weights cast to BF16 and the saved/reloaded BF16 inference model on fixed full-audio prefixes.
Freeze sentinel manifest, checkpoint selection protocol and score parser before v2 free generation.

future_controls.attention_effect: base->full and base->mask start from identical base and share sample order, tokens, optimizer, training horizon and checkpoint-selection budget
future_controls.matched_step_reporting: Report each common completed checkpoint at identical optimizer steps; separately report each arm's best under the same selection budget. Do not attribute unequal training exposure solely to attention.
future_controls.adaptation_effect: if mask SFT starts from full SFT, compare with full->full continuation for the same extra data and updates
future_controls.rl_effect: matched SFT initialization -> ordinary all-token RL vs entropy-gated RL; retain the corresponding no-RL SFT checkpoint
future_controls.mask_contract: reference boundaries, causal absolute positions, padding/sample isolation and generated-history visibility are identical in training, cached generation and log-probability replay
future_controls.dynamic_cache: retain reference plus k_max initially; never resurrect evicted KV when window grows without recorded recomputation
future_controls.entropy_contract: FP32 full-vocabulary reduction; output-token coordinates; explicitly defined temperature, token classes, quantile population, tie handling, denominator and KL routing
